basis.freshness_check: main advanced 8 commits after anchor; compare file-set touched hyperposition/WAL/ClayCode diagnostic files, not the audited effect/presence/V16/truth-gate sources
basis.existing_overlap: presence_execution_generation_effect_fence already OPEN; active candidate branches/PRs exist, therefore no target mutation was attempted

findings.summary: Canonical V14 EffectLifecycleRuntime begin_attempt/retry paths are not bound to the exact admitted V15/V16 execution generation and can enter COMMITTING from stale/internal callers.

record_outcome(effect_id, ...) and reconcile_uncertain_outcome(effect_id, ...) do not require attempt_id. After a same-key retry, a delayed result from an older attempt can terminalize the currently stored attempt because outcome attribution is effect-level, not attempt-level.
findings.falsifier: Create attempt A, mark unknown, retry as attempt B, then deliver A outcome while B is current; runtime must reject A rather than mutate B.

findings.summary: record_outcome accepts caller-controlled verified=true with arbitrary/empty evidence and no provider receipt/evidence schema validation. This is weaker than Clay semantic verified-outcome requirements.
findings.falsifier: Attempt to record verified success with empty evidence; canonical runtime must fail closed.

findings.summary: FrankExecutionContinuityRuntime.bind_execution_and_request can overwrite the singleton execution_id while the V15 lease_epoch is unchanged. Existing context is only distinguished when its epoch differs; same-epoch execution identity replacement is not rejected.
findings.impact: Breaks exact execution-generation identity and invalidates fence candidates that bind only lease_epoch/session/client capability but not execution_id.
findings.falsifier: Under one live BUSY lease epoch bind exec-A then bind exec-B; second bind must fail or be an exact idempotent replay, never replace CURRENT.

findings.summary: repo_truth_gate checks worktree-vs-HEAD only for CRITICAL_FILES. Authoritative executable files including effect_lifecycle_runtime.py, frank_execution_gate.py, frank_execution_continuity.py and claycode/frank_effects.clay are not in that set. HEAD can equal origin/main and the gate can still PASS while dirty unadmitted runtime code executes.
findings.falsifier: Modify a non-CRITICAL production runtime file without committing while all critical files remain clean; preflight must not return PASS.

findings.summary: apply_current_schema canonical chain includes V13-V16, while repo_truth_gate and APPLIED_SCHEMA_MANIFEST_REQUIRED still define UnifiedDB 12.0 and omit V13-V16 feature files/tables. A truth-gate PASS therefore does not itself prove presence/effect/execution schema completeness.
findings.falsifier: Construct a materialization satisfying the V12 manifest/truth-gate checks but lacking a V14/V15/V16 required table; preflight must fail with schema migration required.

findings.summary: Newest Research Center target-VPS adjudication records repo_static_integrity FAIL for DIRECT_CANONICAL_DB_OPEN in runtime/clay_vps_mcp_v02/tests/test_stack.py and SCHEMA_EXECUTESCRIPT_OUTSIDE_MIGRATOR in effect_terminal_runtime_v17_candidate.py.
V16 request idempotency keys bind credential/session/client/request_id but no request payload/semantic hash. Reusing a request_id with changed content cannot be distinguished at this layer.
findings.falsifier: Same principal/session/request_id with different canonical payload hash must be rejected as idempotency conflict, not replayed.

findings.summary: TokenCredentialStore is an immutable in-memory binding snapshot. Updating/revoking the underlying digest file after process start does not update an existing core, so hot revocation semantics require explicit reload/versioning or bounded process lifetime.

Presence status reports stored BUSY/RECOVERING without expiry interpretation; acquire can take over an expired holder while heartbeat/release reject expiry. The inconsistency becomes high-risk because canonical V14 effects are not epoch-fenced.

Caller-bound effect fence candidate persists lease_epoch, holder session/client hashes and process capability fingerprint but no V16 execution_id. Its live validation checks V16 lease_epoch but not execution_id, so the V16 same-epoch rebind bug leaves the old fence apparently live. Candidate must bind exact execution_id/credential generation or first make same-epoch execution replacement impossible.
Owner-fixed self.root server-binary identity remains blocked by stale CURRENT-eligible identity semantics; recent main delta inspected in this audit did not touch the cited identity surfaces.

strongest_counterhypotheses: Some low-level runtime methods may be unreachable from the eventual production transport; reachability can downgrade exploitability but does not repair the violated persistence invariant.

V12 may intentionally remain a base schema version while V13-V16 are feature schemas; even then the current truth-gate/manifest still does not prove required current feature presence and must expose a separate feature-schema contract.

Process-local flock and ingress routing reduce some stale-owner races on one host; they do not repair same-epoch V16 rebinding, attempt-outcome attribution, dirty-worktree truth, or exact execution binding.
Immutable credential snapshots can be acceptable only if process restart/reload on revocation is an explicit measured contract; no such long-lived network API acceptance is currently promoted.
recommended_order: 1 truth-gate full executable/runtime worktree admission + feature-schema completeness
2 V16 forbid same-epoch execution identity replacement and enforce live non-expired holder/credential identity
3 effect reservation/attempt/provider-precommit fence bound to exact execution_id plus lease epoch and caller identity
4 make outcomes/reconciliation attempt_id-bound and evidence-schema/provider-receipt validated
5 rebase/replay active fence candidate on fresh main; do not merge stale branch directly
6 close current repo_static_integrity failures before promotion
7 bind ingress idempotency to canonical request payload hash and define hot token revocation semantics
8 rerun exact-current target-VPS lifecycle, crash/retry/reconciliation, static integrity, ClayCode frontend/TypedIR and recovery gates
